newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bomb defused in renewed ETA violence in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Bomb defused in renewed ETA violence in Spain.

text.p: Spanish police defused a bomb containing 10 kg (22 lb) of explosive on Saturday planted outside a tax office in San Sebastian in the northern Basque region.
An anonymous caller claiming to represent Basque separatist rebel group ETA alerted police to the bomb.

Earlier in the week a Spanish army officer was shot and killed in Madrid in what officials believe was an ETA assassination. The car supposedly used by the attackers later blew up nearby injuring a member of the Royal Guard who was passing by.
Another small bomb was defused and three others exploded near electricity towers in the northern Cantabria region last weekend.

Spain's Interior Minister warned early in the week that the separatists could be planning actions in retaliation for recent police arrests of violent youth groups that support ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom), which has killed some 800 people in its 28-year drive for Basque independence.
